items.title: Fractional Decay
items.prompt: Identify the number that logically replaces the question mark in this mathematical sequence.
items.hint: Examine the divisor applied at each step.
items.explanation: Each term is divided by an incrementing integer: 120 / 2 = 60, 60 / 3 = 20, 20 / 4 = 5, and 5 / 5 = 1.

items.title: Cloud Weight Reality
items.prompt: A typical white cumulus cloud weighs as much as about 100 elephants (roughly 500,000 kg).
items.hint: Consider the vast volume of water droplets suspended in the air.
items.explanation: A typical cumulus cloud has a volume of around one cubic kilometer and contains approximately 500,000 kilograms of liquid water droplets.

items.title: Segment Counter
items.prompt: How many individual, non-overlapping unit triangles are shown inside the central geometric figure?

svgDiagram.caption: Regular hexagon subdivided into internal triangular units

items.hint: Count the smallest triangular sectors radiating from the center.
items.explanation: A regular hexagon divided by diagonals passing through its center forms exactly 6 non-overlapping equilateral unit triangles.

items.title: The Museum Shift
items.prompt: Four docents—Elena, Marcus, Priya, and David—each guard a different hall: Antiquities, Coins, Fossils, or Textiles. Who guards the Fossils?
clues: 1. Marcus and David guard neither Coins nor Textiles.
items.hint: Start by identifying Marcus's hall once Elena takes Antiquities.
items.explanation: With Elena at Antiquities, Marcus and David must split Coins and Fossils; because Marcus cannot guard Fossils, David must guard Fossils.

items.title: Elemental Oddity
items.prompt: Which of these chemical elements does not share a key physical trait with the other three at standard room temperature and pressure?
items.hint: Consider standard classification into metals and nonmetals.
items.explanation: Bromine is a nonmetal (halogen), whereas Mercury, Gallium, and Cesium are all metals.

items.title: Planetary Distance Ladder
items.prompt: Arrange these four Solar System bodies in increasing order of their average distance from the Sun (closest to farthest).
items.hint: Remember the asteroid belt lies between the inner rocky planets and the gas giants.
items.explanation: Venus orbits at ~0.72 AU, Mars at ~1.52 AU, the dwarf planet Ceres in the asteroid belt at ~2.77 AU, and Jupiter at ~5.20 AU.

items.title: Orbital Energy Sum
items.prompt: Select exactly 3 energy nodes on the grid so their combined values total exactly 50 gigajoules.

gridPuzzle.instruction: Select exactly 3 cells that add up to 50.

items.explanation: Selecting nodes 14 (index 1), 18 (index 4), and 18 (index 7) yields 14 + 18 + 18 = 50. No other 3-cell combination sums to 50.

items.title: The Silent Carrier
items.prompt: I have a spine, but no bones. I have leaves, but no branches. I can transport you across centuries without taking a single step. What am I?
items.explanation: A book features a binding spine and pages (traditionally called leaves), carrying readers through historic tales without moving anywhere.
